title: Sing It Back To Me (Song Pal)
style: A cappella future-bass-infused jazz blues. One expressive male vocalist carries the entire arrangement, stacking lush harmonies and rhythmic vocal chops that imitate sidechained synth leads and brass stabs. The groove blends swing-inflected blue-note phrasing with modern future-bass drops and bright, syncopated vocal hits. Tight, intimate production emphasizes breath, mouth percussion, and layered choral pads to create the sense of pulsing electronic leads and brassy accents using only the human voice.
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Yeah)
Like a song pal
(Be my song pal)
Sing it back to me
(Back to me, back to me)

[Verse 1]
Yeah
Like a song pal
You could be my song pal forever
We should just be song pals, not text pals
We’re gonna get it right, you’ll sing, pal
I know what’s right tonight

I went away to go and find my way
You came along and you heard my melody
You stayed and listened while I played that tune
And now it’s you I want to hear sing back to me

No more pen pals, no more text at all
I want your heartbeat keeping time with me
Just your warm chest humming to my call
To a tune like I said, baby sing it back to me

[Chorus]
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Sing it back to me, sing it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Like I said, baby, sing it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Every little note, send it back to me
Be my song pal, be my song pal
Like I said, baby, sing it back to me
